peer_read_only_review: Confirmed argument, including absence of positional/other context reads and bound preservation under native C++ simplification.
proof: With base_size=1, a valid Solve produces [] or [f(x)] from one singleton value.
Equal singleton values have identical observable context.
Combine only concatenates/selects recursive lists and creates no new scalar values.
Consequently distinct(output)<=distinct(input)=8, but the first test target has 9 distinct values.
Thus no legal program, before or after native C++ simplification, can achieve zero error on this fixed test.
